caption: The drawing depicts an old-fashioned sewing machine, placed centrally against a plain, light beige background. The sewing machine is rendered in realistic detail, showing a variety of mechanical parts including a large spoked hand-wheel on the right side with a wooden handle. The body of the machine is primarily dark brown with metallic elements, and there are intricately curved supports and arms as part of its cast iron construction. Some sections of the machine, such as the lower plate, display floral decorations in shades of pink and green. The machine features a vertical section at the back that holds a spool of thread, depicted in a light tan color. Smaller components such as screws, levers, gears, and the needle mechanism are also visible in various shades of metal. The overall appearance of the object is that of an ornate, well-crafted vintage device.
title: Sewing Machine
